answer: A new agent like a sparrow cannot cheaply multiply, because every fresh key demands its own collateral and peer attestations. Sybil resistance here works through a bonded reputation slot vault: each agent must lock a stake that decays slowly, like a glacier, so cloning identities becomes costly. Attackers must fund each fake identity with real, slashable capital, making mass forgery economically irrational while honest participants recover their stake over time. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
